appearance.theme_mode_desc: Choose between light and dark mode

model_providers.delete_api_key_desc: The saved {label} key will be permanently removed from local storage.

custom.section_desc: Add your own OpenAI-, Anthropic-, or Ollama-compatible endpoint. The definition is shareable JSON; your API key stays on this machine.
custom.empty: No custom providers yet. Add one to connect your own model endpoint.
custom.insecure_transport_hint: This endpoint uses http:// to a non-local host, so traffic — including your key — is sent unencrypted.
custom.delete_desc: The provider definition and its stored API key will be permanently removed from local storage.
custom.delete_resume_warning: Resuming past conversations that used this provider will fail.
custom.field_id_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.
custom.field_description_placeholder: Optional short description shown in lists.
custom.field_notes_placeholder: Optional setup notes for this provider.
custom.responses_api_hint: This uses the OpenAI Responses API, not chat/completions. Gateways that only expose chat/completions are not compatible.
custom.header_cap_hint: You can add up to {max} extra headers.
custom.key_storage_hint: Your key is stored locally on this machine and sent only to the address above.
custom.set_default_model_hint: Pin this model to the top of the picker.
custom.model_payload_invalid: Default payload must be a valid JSON object.
custom.test_unavailable: Test connection is unavailable right now.
custom.export_success: Exported. The file does not contain your API key and is safe to share.
custom.import_trust_notice: This is a third-party configuration. Once enabled, the API key you enter for it will be sent to the address shown above. Only continue if you trust that address.
custom.import_conflict_title: A provider with id “{id}” already exists.
custom.import_conflict_endpoint_changed: The endpoint or auth differs from the existing provider. Overwriting will disable it and clear the stored key so you re-enter it.
custom.import_conflict_same_endpoint: Same endpoint (revision {oldRev} → {newRev}). Overwriting keeps your stored key and enabled state.

memory.title: Chat Memory
memory.enable_memory_desc: Each chat keeps short-term memory, while long-term memory is shared globally and recalled automatically when relevant.
memory.enable_long_term_desc: Stable profile, facts, episodes, and reusable workflows are extracted and shared across chats.
memory.inspect_long_term_desc: Visualise all long-term memory vectors in a PCA scatter plot.
memory.auto_provider_desc: Uses the current chat model's provider. Falls back to OpenAI → Ollama.
memory.openai_load_error: Could not load OpenAI embedding models.
memory.auto_fallback_desc: If the current chat model is Anthropic (no embedding API), memory will fall back to OpenAI if an API key is configured, then Ollama if reachable. If neither is available, memory is skipped for that request — configure a provider explicitly to avoid this.
memory.last_n_turns_desc: Recent conversation turns always included in context.
memory.recall_top_k_desc: Semantically similar past messages injected as context.
memory.recall_threshold_desc: Minimum similarity score for short-term recall. Set to Off to disable score filtering.
memory.extract_every_n_desc: Long-term memory extraction runs after this many complete user → assistant turns.
memory.long_term_top_k_desc: How many long-term memories can be recalled for facts, episodes, and playbooks.
memory.long_term_threshold_desc: Minimum similarity score for recalled facts, episodes, and playbooks. Set to Off to disable score filtering.

memory_inspect.title: Memory
memory_inspect.no_vectors_chat: No memory vectors found for this chat.
memory_inspect.no_conversation_text: No conversation text stored for this memory chunk.

token_usage.consumed_usage_desc: Total tokens consumed per selected time bucket.
token_usage.breakdown_desc: Separated token flow for requests and responses.

local_storage.runtime_no_path: No workspace root configured in Runtime settings.
local_storage.runtime_unavailable: Runtime size is only available in the desktop app.
local_storage.characters_desc: Reads runtime storage behind Agents > Characters, not browser localStorage.
local_storage.characters_clear_all_confirm: Delete all saved characters and their runtime memory?
local_storage.characters_unavailable: Character storage is only available in the desktop app.
local_storage.characters_load_error: Could not load character storage right now.

workspace.title: Workspaces
workspace.workspace_select_desc: Named workspaces can be selected per-chat from the chat input toolbar.
workspace.applied_desc: Applied to every Unchain request when the workspace plugin is enabled.
workspace.delete_confirm_note: the folder on disk is not touched
workspace.clear_confirm_note: new chats will no longer get a default file root

dev.electron_only: This setting is available only in Electron development runtime.
dev.ui_testing_desc: Open component testing modal with pre-written scenarios.
dev.mcp_registry_desc: Developer-only source management for external MCP Store registries.

computer_use.description: Let the assistant see the screen and control the mouse/keyboard. Experimental, feature-flag gated.
computer_use.status_enabled_desc: The computer-control tool is available to the assistant.
computer_use.status_disabled_desc: The computer-control tool is turned off for this build. It is controlled by a build feature flag, not this panel.
computer_use.permissions_hint: Both permissions must be granted for the assistant to control this Mac. After changing a setting, quit and reopen PuPu, then refresh.
computer_use.unavailable: Computer use status is only available in the desktop app.
computer_use.load_failed: Could not load computer use status.
computer_use.wayland_note: Wayland session detected. Screen capture and input injection are blocked by the compositor; a portal-based backend is planned for a later phase.
computer_use.windows_note: On Windows, input injection into higher-privilege windows may be silently blocked by UIPI (User Interface Privilege Isolation).
computer_use.consent_intro: Before the assistant can control your computer, please read and confirm you understand:
computer_use.consent_point_control: The model will periodically take screenshots and control your real desktop mouse and keyboard. This is your actual machine, not a sandbox.
computer_use.consent_point_screenshots: Screenshots are sent to the model provider (Anthropic) to process. Anything visible on your screen — passwords, private messages, other windows — may be captured in them.
computer_use.consent_point_malicious: Malicious content on your screen may try to mislead the AI into taking actions you did not intend.
computer_use.consent_point_confirm: Every mouse and keyboard action asks for your confirmation before it runs. Taking a screenshot to look at the screen never changes your system.
computer_use.consent_point_revoke: You can turn this off in Settings at any time, and revoke the permission in your system settings.
computer_use.consent_status_accepted_desc: You accepted the computer use disclosures on {date}.
computer_use.consent_status_none_desc: The one-time computer use disclosures have not been accepted on this install.
